csv_comments: '- Project Number: 2026-02- Contract Number: RFP-120568- Pre-Submittal Notes: A non-mandatory pre-proposal meeting will be held on May 5, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Interested offerors shall meet in the parking lot of Pocahontas Landmark Center, located at 4290 Anderson Highway, Powhatan, VA 23139. The meeting will include a summary of the project followed by a walkthrough of the campus, excluding the B Wing. Offerors will be permitted to use their own drones during the site walkthrough. Offerors are encouraged to wear personal protective equipment, especially masks, during the site visit. Offerors will be required to sign a Release and Waiver of Liability to participate in the building walkthrough and to operate a drone on the property. This will be the only time County and School staff will be available to conduct a site walkthrough.- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 05/05/2026 09:00 PM EDT- Pre-Submittal Location: 4290 Anderson Hwy, POWHATAN, VA, 23139, USA- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Recommended- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/02/2026 12:00 PM EDT Pre-Bid meeting May 5 at 09:00 PM EDT
title: A/E Services for Pocahontas Landmark Center Feasibility Study
short_description: Feasibility study for redevelopment or reuse of the Pocahontas Landmark Center campus.
project_scope: Professional architectural and engineering services to perform a feasibility study for the Pocahontas Landmark Center campus in Powhatan, Virginia. The notice indicates a campus walkthrough, excluding the B Wing, but provides no building size, gross floor area, structural system, or technical characteristics.
services: Architectural and engineering services for a feasibility study, including architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- Early-stage feasibility study only; no defined structural or bridge design scope.
- General building project with no indication of long spans, special structures, or architecturally demanding load-bearing systems.
- Requested disciplines focus on architecture, space planning, programming, and cost estimating.
- Could offer limited strategic entry if the site later develops into a larger building project, but current notice is weakly aligned with sbp's core strengths.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The source only mentions a feasibility study for the Pocahontas Landmark Center campus and requested services in architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, and cost estimating; no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is only a feasibility study without stated budget, area, or scope definition, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms for professional architectural and engineering services; no specific reference counts, project types, or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
